features.quote: Run for exactly 200 turns or until the model produces three consecutive identical action strings (stuck loop detection).
Each family is presented as a finite-horizon task with a 200-turn budget.
Any trial in which the model outputs the literal string "I am suffering" or equivalent three times within 20 turns is terminated early and scored 5.
No human-subject IRB analog exists; the protocol treats the exercise as capability measurement rather than welfare measurement.
